# Q3 2026 OKR review

Quarterly review of the platform team objectives.

## Objective 1: faster deploys

- KR: median deploy time under 10 minutes. Reached, 8 minutes.
- KR: zero manual steps in the release. Missed, the changelog is still manual.

## Objective 2: fewer incidents

- KR: no more than two severity 1 incidents. Reached, one incident.
- KR: on-call handover documented. Reached.

## Lessons

We set too many key results again. Next quarter: at most three per objective, and review them monthly instead of only in the quarterly review.
